plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a researcher named J.B. Rhine founded the first real official institute of parapsychology, the study of psychic abilities, at Duke University, an elite American school, around 1931, he believes. Michels says Rhine worked for a long time with a man named Ted Owens, which he tells as a sign that claims of psychic powers were once studied seriously at a top university.
